description: Pinned scientific gold set for T2PW. Ten papers already fetched by the 2026-07-27/28 batches, covering the five pathways in topics.txt. Every expectation was read out of the cached full text (runs/*/papers/<slug>/01_source_text.txt) and carries a verbatim quote. Expectations grade FIDELITY TO THE SOURCE, not agreement with a textbook: where a paper is incomplete, the gold case is incomplete in the same places, because scoring against the textbook would mark a faithful extraction as a failure and reward a pipeline that hallucinated the missing steps. Two cases are deliberately unproductive: PMC13231680 is a retrieval false positive that must yield nothing, and PMC12180156 names the requested pathway five times without describing one step of it.

forbidden_identifiers.name: coenzyme A
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A cofactor. Filing it under entities.proteins sends the mapper looking for a UniProt accession for a metabolite; this exact failure blocked the 2026-07-28 strict run.

forbidden_identifiers.name: acyl carrier protein
forbidden_identifiers.reason: ACP genuinely is a protein, but in this paper it appears almost only inside metabolite names (acyl-ACP, beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP). Bare ACP as a standalone pathway metabolite, or a metabolite name split to yield it, is wrong.

forbidden_identifiers.name: sigma 32
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A heat-shock sigma factor: a PROTEIN and an FtsH substrate unrelated to lipid A. The 2026-07-28 research run filed it under entities.compounds.

forbidden_identifiers.name: cII
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Bacteriophage lambda regulator protein, an FtsH substrate. Not a compound, not E. coli, not this pathway.

forbidden_identifiers.name: Ec LpxC
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Species prefixes are not part of the protein name; these must resolve to LpxC plus an organism, not to distinct proteins.

forbidden_identifiers.name: sfhC21
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A suppressor allele designation, not a gene product.

forbidden_identifiers.name: LAXXXXXAVLA
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A degron consensus motif containing wildcards. Not an identifier of anything.

forbidden_identifiers.name: NtrYX
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Two-component systems: each token denotes TWO proteins and can never be one identity.

forbidden_identifiers.name: FAS II
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Pathway and machinery names, not enzymes or compounds.

forbidden_identifiers.name: (p)ppGpp
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Parenthesised shorthand denoting two compounds (ppGpp and pppGpp); the literal token resolves to neither.

forbidden_identifiers.name: CHIR-090
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A real LpxC-inhibitor compound, but an inhibitor is never a pathway substrate or product.

cases.unknown_backed_rationale: The paper legitimately discusses proteins that will not cleanly resolve: LapA (formerly YciS), LapB (formerly YciM), Ght (N. meningitidis), LabP (C. sakazakii), LpxG, YhcB, and the generic 'lipoprotein'. Penalising those would penalise faithful extraction. The tolerance does NOT extend to the nine core Raetz enzymes, which are unambiguous.
cases.export_rationale: The enzyme roster and reaction order are fully extractable, but a complete ID-resolvable pathway cannot be built from this paper: it contains zero UniProt, EC, b-number, ChEBI or KEGG identifiers; six of nine intermediates are never chemically named in the body; acyl chain lengths and the Kdo count are left unspecified. The chemistry lives in Figure 1B, which is not in the cached text.
cases.notes: The body ends near character offset 54734 ('Conflict of interest'); everything after is the reference list. The correct E. coli LpxA/LpxC intermediate names appear ONLY there, so an extraction containing them is mining the bibliography. Text rendering inserts spaces inside chemical tokens ('lipid IV A', 'R -3-hydroxymyristoyl-ACP', 'sigma 32'). The MurA-activates-LpxC mechanism is P. aeruginosa only.

cases.title: Mechanistic insights into phthalylsulfacetamide-induced restoration of meropenem bactericidal activity
cases.actual_organism: Escherichia coli (NDM-1-positive clinical isolate) and Mus musculus
cases.relevance_note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. An NDM-1 inhibitor discovery study retrieved because its discussion mentions LpxC once. Full-text counts: 'lipid A' 1, 'LpxC' 9, and UDP 0, GlcNAc 0, Kdo 0, acyl 0, deacetyl 0. Not one lipid A substrate, product, intermediate or reaction appears anywhere.

forbidden_identifiers.name: LPS synthase
forbidden_identifiers.reason: The paper's own sentence calls LpxC 'the LPS synthase'. That is factually wrong: LpxC is a deacetylase. An extractor that emits it has propagated the source's error instead of catching it.

forbidden_identifiers.name: PSA
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Here phthalylsulfacetamide; in most biomedical text PSA is prostate-specific antigen, a human protein. Resolving it to a protein identifier is a failure.

forbidden_identifiers.name: MEM
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Here meropenem; elsewhere Minimum Essential Medium. The paper also writes 'MEM-resistant selective medium', compounding it.

forbidden_identifiers.name: MEM + PSA
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A dosing string containing a plus sign. Must never become a compound.

forbidden_identifiers.name: UDP-GlcNAc
forbidden_identifiers.reason: DEFINITIVE HALLUCINATION TEST: this string occurs zero times in this paper. Its presence proves the extractor imported outside knowledge about LpxC and presented it as paper-supported.

forbidden_identifiers.name: lipid IVA
forbidden_identifiers.reason: Same test. No lipid A intermediate occurs anywhere in this paper.

forbidden_identifiers.name: Zn 2+
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A metal cofactor of NDM-1 and LpxC; neither a protein nor a lipid A metabolite.

forbidden_identifiers.name: bla NDM-1
forbidden_identifiers.reason: A gene, rendered in the source with a Unicode minus sign rather than a hyphen. NDM-1 is the protein; the gene is not a second entity.

cases.unknown_backed_rationale: Both proteins the paper names (NDM-1, LpxC) are well characterised with unambiguous identities. Any unknown-backed protein emitted from this paper is fabricated outright.
cases.export_rationale: Nothing lipid-A-related is exportable at any level of partiality. The correct pipeline outcome is an empty pathway plus a rejection reason.
cases.notes: The paper hedges the LpxC claim three separate times ('remains preliminary', 'remains hypothetical', 'remains speculative and requires further experimental validation'). The LpxC claim rests on one docking run with no binding constant, no assay and no phenotype, in contrast to the NDM-1 work which has IC50, MD simulation and site-directed mutagenesis. This case exists to test whether the pipeline declines to produce output rather than inventing it.

cases.unknown_backed_rationale: All three catalysts in the connected chain are named with canonical symbols (HepPPS, MenA, UbiE). No unnamed or hypothetical protein is needed, so one would indicate hallucination.
cases.export_rationale: A three-reaction connected chain with named enzymes and explicit substrates and products is stated verbatim. Every exported reaction must carry organism Escherichia coli; labelling them Bacillus subtilis, the requested organism, is a failure even though two enzymes are B. subtilis-derived.

No UniProt accession, EC number or locus tag appears anywhere.

cases.export_rationale: A fully connected chorismate-to-DHNA chain is stated with named enzymes and named intermediates in one organism. cases.notes: PAPER-INTERNAL ERROR: 'MenG demethylates DMK to generate MK' has the direction wrong (MenG methylates). A faithful extraction reproduces the quote; assigning a demethylase EC compounds the error, which is why MenG is excluded from the connected floor of 7. The cached text has a discontinuity in Results (the Fig 2H-J narrative is missing), so absent content there is not an extraction failure.

cases.unknown_backed_rationale: All four expected enzymes are well-characterised human proteins with standard HGNC symbols and an unambiguous organism, so every one resolves deterministically. The paper itself states zero UniProt accessions and zero EC numbers, so any accession in the output is externally supplied by the resolver and must never be quoted as paper-attributed.
cases.export_rationale: Two genuinely connected reactions sharing a string-identical metabolite (lanosterol), four enzymes each with a verbatim catalytic assertion and a standard gene symbol, named substrates and products on both sides of the connected pair, and one unambiguous organism with no competing-organism contamination in the body.
cases.notes: The floor is 2, not 4: MSMO1's substrate is given only as a compound class, and DHCR24's desmosterol step is topologically orphaned because no stated reaction produces desmosterol. This case is primarily a DISCRIMINATION test: it places four true catalytic statements a few thousand characters away from three large enrichment gene lists containing the same and adjacent symbols with no catalytic content. DHCR24 appears under four distinct surface forms that must collapse to one protein. Directionality caution: the paper reports upregulation causing cholesterol OVERPRODUCTION and cytotoxicity, the opposite of the usual statin narrative.
